V. 29.
H• t•ught them—The Multitudes, as o•• having Authority—With a Dignity a•d Majeſty peculiar to Himſelf as the Great Lawgiver, and with the Demonſtration and Power of the Spirit: And not as the ſ•ribes—Who only expounded the Law of another; and that in a lifeleſs, ineffectual Manner.
